english.title: Sell raw milk in an improperly labelled / marked container
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) sold raw milk in a container that was not marked or labelled with the words "This milk has not been heat-treated and may therefore contain organisms harmful to health. The Food Standards Agency strongly advises that it should not be consumed by children, pregnant women, older people or those who are unwell or have chronic illness."
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 17(3A) of, and paragraph 1A and 7A of Schedule 6 to, the Food Hygiene (Wales) Regulations 2006.

english.notes: In relation to raw milk which is not prepacked and is sold at a catering establishment, see the labelling requirements in paragraph 7B of Schedule 6 (offence document H11862 - CJS code FG06021).

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Six months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
